records.title: Regimental transport fields and minor interruptions, first part
records.header_literal: B) ZON v UKS (01.17 a.m., November 29th); 1130 (11/28) (VON BSL); 1 TL RICHI-254
records.readable_german: ARMEE?KDOXX. REGIMENSSTAB mit 2BAONJX und P Eisenbahnbaucomp. Nachfolgend J TRANSP. LANDW 1KXJ sind nach Beseitigung leichter Unterbrechungen
records.meaning: The first part lists a regimental staff, battalion and railway-construction company fields, and a following transport. It says minor interruptions have been overcome and continues with the journey and arrival report in part 2. The opening command designation and unit or quantity labels remain unresolved.
notes: All 254 occupied source slots are retained. The source contains one complete group of five dashes; four of its values are supplied explicitly, while the remaining command-field erasure stays unknown.
The raw ARMEE?KDOXX unknown has domain {4, 8, A, K, O, U}. It is not filled with a separator or a presumed army designation.
REGIMENSSTAB is retained without inserting the absent T of a familiar spelling. The labels 2BAONJX, P, J TRANSP and LANDW 1KXJ are not converted into historical unit numbers or quantities.

EISENBAHLBUUCOMP to EISENBAHNBAUCOMP, NACCFOLGEND to NACHFOLGEND, TRANMP to TRANSP, NAKH to NACH, BEREITIGUNG to BESEITIGUNG and UNL?RBRECHU?GEN to UNTERBRECHUNGEN are explicitly priced word proposals.
The Nov28–Dec1 key uses Y as the separator label. X remains literal within fields, including KDOXX and 1KXJ.

records.title: Journey via literal route labels and arrival with assistance
records.header_literal: B) ZON v UKS (01.17 a.m., November 29th); 1130 (11/28) (VON BSL); 2 TL RICHI-212
records.readable_german: Von POEST7EN I TRENCSEN ueber PUHO in SILEIN in der Nacht am J0 eingetroffen. Jede Unterstuetzung gefunden. R I RGTJX.
records.meaning: The continuation reports arrival in SILEIN during the night represented by J0, after a journey from the literal POEST7EN I TRENCSEN route field via PUHO, and says every assistance was received. The place spellings, date-like label and closing unit field are not silently normalized or independently identified.
notes: The native 212-coordinate second part has no source erasures or length changes. The sole word proposal 1EDE to JEDE costs two observed-coordinate substitutions.
POEST7EN retains its numeral-like 7, and SILEIN retains the source-length spelling. Neither is silently converted into a presumed historical place name.
J0, I and RGTJX remain literal. The body date-like label is not chosen from the November29 interception header or the separate 11/28 originating line.

prior_credit: Published period keys: George Lasry, Ingo Niebel, Nils Kopal and Arno Wacker (2016), and George Lasry (2017 key list). Earlier repository OCR and unchanged-key outputs are retained separately. Source review and explicit editorial work: icekylinx and GPT-6 Astra Pro. No universal first-decipherment priority is asserted.
limits: All native source slots remain in printed order; no insertion, deletion or reordering.
Unknown square cells remain globally coupled and injective. Roundtrip completion witnesses are explicitly nonhistorical.
Observed-coordinate substitutions and source-mask fills are priced separately. A source-compatible word proposal is not proof of unique historical wording.
